notes.title: Beacon Patrol is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Ahoy Sailors!


The wait is over: Beacon Patrol has officially set sail on Steam!
Grab your crew, chart the coastline, and work together to build the most complete map of the North Sea.


✨ What you can expect:
Cozy and relaxing coastal exploration

Solo or co-op play with friends

Strategic tile placement & high replayability

The full board game experience, including the Ships & Shores expansion

Extra digital-only content and modes

A huge thank you to everyone who joined the playtests, shared feedback, and supported us along the way. We couldn’t have done it without you! ❤️


Set sail today, as your patrol starts now:[previewyoutube="Qc8HZJcRIR0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Version 0.8.10
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're so happy to finally bring you the cute companions you deserve at sea!
Your seagull friend will be at your side while you map these uncharted waters.

In a future update we plan to bring tips and comments to our little fellas, but for now they just cheer you on and celebrate when you complete missions or score points.

You can unlock new seagull buddies by reaching new ranks in-game.

Furthermore we have finally added the possibility to have a look at your finished map once you have finished a game.


 Game Over Screen now allows you to move the camera and look at your finished map
 Added animated seagull companions in-game
 Seagulls can be unlocked by reaching new ranks (sailor, captain, navigator, cartographer)
 Minor bug fixes


Happy sailing to you and your seagull friends!

notes.title: Version 0.8.5
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

While version 0.8.5 brings a lot of changes under the hood, bug fixes for controller support is the only bigger change visible for now.


 Updated Input System
 Corrected swapped button glyphs for Switch Pro Controllers 
 Added animation to Player Setup screen
 Fixed input issues with UI in some edge cases
 Undoing the exploration of a tile now correctly hides that tiles score again 


Hope you enjoy the quality of life changes.

Happy sailing!

notes.title: Version 0.7.30
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Version 0.7.30 brings a cleaner UI and proper support for all modern controllers with correct icons 🎮
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44589713/bca6d68838bb898a77b01a7008f12ac61b72cd1f.png


 Updated User Interface for easier readability
 Fixed Controller Input Issues regarding the "How to Play" popup and settings menu
 Extended controller input icons for controllers:

 Steamdeck
 Xbox One Controllers
 Dualshock (Playstation 4 Controllers)
 DualSense (Playstation 5 Controllers)
 Switch Pro Controllers


These updates should make gameplay using controllers much smoother.

Happy sailing!

notes.title: Version 0.7.24
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Version 0.7.24 brings full controller support, new ship colors, detailed placement indicators and much more ⛵️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44589713/6e32b336e60171efce80bdc623917aed65568274.gif


 Full Controller Support (leave us some feedback! We know there is some room for improvement)
 More Ship Colours
 Select your Background, Ship Color and Flag Icon before playing
 Placement Indicators finally showing why tiles may not be placed in invalid locations (wrong edges, unreachable by boat)
 Score for each Tile is always shown by default (can be disabled in settings)
 German Localisation (The first of many languages to come)
 Tutorial can be reset or disabled in Settings
 Many, many bug fixes to general UI behaviour regarding hand tiles and 3d previews of tiles


This version of First Horizons is much smoother to play than before.
We have been hard at work and hope you enjoy the improvements!

Happy sailing!

notes.title: Version 0.6.20
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Version 0.6.20 brings some first scoring UI improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44589713/cfcb0cede51d47369832d68b911ed3d9ce59938f.png

- Tiles display their score when you explore them
- Hover over a tile to see its score (if any)
- Hover over the total score on the top left to see all tile scores

On a side note, the menus are now controllable with keyboard and controller.
This is not exciting yet, but full controller support is in the works!

notes.title: Version 0.6.16
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're releasing a small fix with version 0.6.16.


 Hovering over tiles in your hand does not show a preview beneath the UI anymore.


As always: happy sailing!
